decided: 2026-10-14 — owner chose a declared, transparent prior with recorded receipts until a validation target exists (OWNER_PRODUCT_BACKLOG_SPEC.md §2.3: exact ranking weights require validation before production).
note: These weights ORDER candidates that already passed every hard rule (canonical win, opponent even-or-better on a whole-package-covered external calculator, topology, posture-justified picks, constraints). They never qualify or disqualify a trade. Each factor is in [0, 1]; forcedDropCost and calculatorDivergence are COSTS and are subtracted. A factor that cannot be computed is reported as null; inside the roster-aware rerank head an unknown lineupImpact / forcedDropCost ranks as the head's worst known value (rankingImputations), never as free.
antiExploit: v2 (2026-10-14 review B1): the prior must not reward the size of the disagreement between our board and the external calculator (OWNER_PRODUCT_BACKLOG_SPEC.md §2.3). externalComfort is a plateau that declines past externalExploitBandPct to 0 at externalExploitZeroPct; calculatorDivergence is the board-value-weighted mean |ln(board / calculator native)| over the package beyond divergenceTolerancePct, saturating at divergenceSaturationRatio. All four bands are declared priors, not validated thresholds.
